critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.js is 1506 lines — exceeds 700 line guideline; consider splitting into smaller components (e.g., extract SystemsSection, PricingSection, FooterSection) for maintainability.

The dynamic count pattern `t('hp_systems_title', \`${systems.length} نظام متكامل\`).replace('{count}', systems.length)` is clever but fragile: if the i18n value comes back with the literal text (no {count} placeholder), the .replace is a no-op which is fine, but if a translation team adds {count} for AR/EN/FR they MUST use the same placeholder name. Recommend documenting the placeholder convention in translations file.
Filter 'جديد' is expected ~22 per request but actual is 19 (matches code: counted 19 isNew=true cards). Request count expectation was off by 3 — code is correct.
Mobile auth endpoint /api/mobile/auth/register requires `role` field (request example in problem statement used `user_type` which returns 422). Document the correct field name in API docs.
